## Pull request overview

This PR resolves TypeScript build failures in four packages (`plugin-report`, `layout`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-grid`) caused by dependency misclassification and missing tsconfig exclude patterns.

**Changes:**
- Moved `@object-ui/*` workspace packages from `peerDependencies` to `dependencies` in `plugin-report` to fix turbo build ordering
- Added standard `exclude` pattern to `tsconfig.json` in `layout`, `plugin-form`, and `plugin-grid` to skip type-checking of stories and test files

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-report/package.json | Moved @object-ui/* packages from peerDependencies to dependencies, aligning with other plugins for correct turbo build ordering |
| packages/plugin-grid/tsconfig.json | Added exclude pattern for node_modules, dist, tests, and stories files |
| packages/plugin-form/tsconfig.json | Added exclude pattern for node_modules, dist, tests, and stories files |
| packages/layout/tsconfig.json | Added exclude pattern for node_modules, dist, tests, and stories files |
